threads.body: PR title/description says versions are being pinned, but this change only adds a lower bound (">=") and still allows newer versions. Either pin exact/compatible versions in this file (and the others in the PR) or adjust the PR metadata to reflect that this is a minimum-version security bump rather than pinning.

This example requirements file switches from a compatible range ("~=") to an unbounded lower bound. Without an upper bound, a future python-dotenv 2.x release could break the examples. Consider keeping the security floor while constraining to 1.x.

The header says these are "pinned requirements" for unit tests, but this entry uses a floating lower bound (">="). To keep CI deterministic and match the file's stated intent, pin this dependency to an exact version.
